_description: SS taxable fraction in the 85% zone. MFJ with higher income tests upper threshold.
_rationale: MFJ, Florida, SS $30k + pension $50k (before_tax) at age 62, haircut disabled, spouse age 60. Provisional = $50k + 0.5 * $30k = $65k. MFJ thresholds $32k/$44k → 85% zone. SS taxable = min(0.85 * ($65k - $44k) + $6k, 0.85 * $30k) = min($23,850, $25,500) = $23,850. Combined taxable gross = $73,850. Deduction = $32,200 (2026 MFJ, both under 65). Taxable = $41,650. Federal tax = $2,480 (10% on $24,800) + $2,022 (12% on $16,850) = $4,502. Net = $75,498/yr.
name: SS Taxable Fraction 85%
